info.name: CertiFlow Backend - JavaScript MVC
info.description: Run npm run seed, npm start, and npm run worker. Run folders 01–03 in order. Folder 04: poll the certificate list until jobs finish, then verify/download. Other folders contain optional actions and negative-state scenarios; do not run every folder blindly. Login requests store each role token; batch submission stores batchId and revision. Credentials are demo-only.
